title: The tour route across Europe and North Africa
summary: The band played Belgium, Switzerland, Holland, Spain, Morocco, Algeria, Libya and Italy.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: It holds round about...I guess about four or five thousand people. So I was playing washboard, playing drums, singing... I think the band was... I think it was two weeks...four weeks there -- two or four weeks. Then we went out to Belgium, Switzerland, Holland, Spain, North Africa,
Where in Spain did you play?
We played at a place in Barcelona.
What about North Africa? Where did you play?
North Africa, that was a small place...North Africa... I met a lot of big people out there, doctors, big doctors out there...
What country are you talking about in North Africa?
You played Tangier in Morocco or Casablanca?
Did you play Tunisia, Algeria, Libya?
So that was a pretty extensive tour. That tour lasted what, about six months?
